problem: Explored. Official docs: a role's tools, disallowedTools, permissionMode, isolation and hooks are frontmatter fields and govern only that agent; frontmatter hooks run only while that agent acts; settings permissions are global, and Agent(name) there is a deny or allow of dispatching that role; Edit/Write denies do not reach subprocess writes, the sandbox denyWrite does.

questions.text: Given those facts, is a role's reach declared like this: the role file is the single source for what the role can do (tools, mode, isolation, its own hooks); settings hold only what no role can express — the sandbox denyWrite list, global recording hooks, and the list of roles a session may dispatch — and the install leaf derives that dispatch list from the crew folder?
questions.why: Closes the two-files-that-contradict hole. The alternative keeps two hand-written files and adds a check.

options.value: no — two hand-maintained files with a check that they agree
